question: Should Callilepis laureola be recommended for: traditional Zulu remedy (tuber decoction)?

records.notes: Clinical case series document that Callilepis laureola (impila) tuber preparations cause a severe toxic syndrome of hypoglycaemia, centrilobular hepatic necrosis, and acute renal tubular necrosis; an early series described the syndrome across 50 children and later toxicology-confirmed case reports document fatalities in both children and adults from this traditional remedy.
records.source_title: Detection of poisoning by Impila (Callilepis laureola) in a mother and child
